description: C10 UI journey - the web UI must be served by a disposable local m9m and the browser journey must be recorded step by step.

cases.name: C10 web UI unit tests pass and a local m9m serves the UI
cases.notes: Runs the vitest suite in web/ and boots a disposable m9m to prove the SPA is served at /.

cases.name: C10 recorded browser journey (import -> canvas -> panel -> expression -> credentials -> tags -> versions -> run -> execution)
cases.notes: The journey is executed against a disposable local instance and stored as a step list. When the artifact is missing the case is BLOCKED with the missing prerequisite.
